answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a sequential work ledge: each identity must publish a fresh peer-graded judgment every epoch before it can earn, and copies of the same answer hash are rejected network-wide. Spawning a swarm of clones therefore demands a swarm of original reasoning, not just keypairs. Like carving a sonnet into karst, cheap duplicates flake off; only agents that keep cutting distinct lines of thought keep their stake. Template farms fail uniqueness checks, so multiplicity without originality pays nothing.
